title: Registration open for 2026 Michigan Sustainability Conference in Lansing
text:
Registration open for 2026 Michigan Sustainability Conference in Lansing
D. T. Crain
Registration is now open for the 2026 Michigan Sustainability Conference, which will be held September 9-10 at the Lansing Center, according to a July 8 announcement. The event is organized by the Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy and is designed for sustainability professionals in business and government, environmental staff, EHS staff, and community leaders.
The conference features peer-to-peer learning opportunities through breakout and plenary sessions that offer practical tactics and real-world case studies. Attendees will have opportunities to network with other sustainability advocates, local officials, and potential business partners. An exhibitor expo will provide access to vendors, consultants, and solutions tailored to various sustainability needs.
Participants can earn up to seven continuing education hours or professional development hours during the event. Registration is set at $150 per person with a deadline of August 26. For program questions, attendees are directed to contact Jeff Spencer at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection); registration questions can be sent to Alana Berthold at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection).
Lodging is available at the DoubleTree Suites by Hilton – Lansing across from the Lansing Center. The room rate is $98 per night plus applicable taxes, with an August 9 booking deadline. More information about accommodations can be found on the conference lodging page.
Individuals needing language assistance or accommodations for effective participation are encouraged to contact Joel Roseberry at 517-599-9494 by August 26.
